Monday, 02 December 2019
5124 Hits
Announcement of National Workshop on Sports Physiology
which will be organized by the Department of Physiology MGIMS, Sevagram on
10th January 2020.
Eminent guest speakers from AIIMS New Delhi,  AIIMS Patna,  AIIMS Mangalagiri, MGMCRI Puducherry, NKP Salve, Nagpur will be here to enlighten us with their expertise in this workshop.
There will be Hands on session for the delegates on various investigations in Sports Physiology.
The Registration form and the brochure are attached herewith
Please send us your confirmation along with your contact details through the link to online form or scan copy of the offline form along with transaction details to
nwsp2020@gmail.com
Link to online form:
https://forms.gle/aWxeqNHxvjeftfXaA
MGIMS is eager to welcome you to the very first Sports Physiology Laboratory of rural central India.
For any queries, please contact
Dr Ruchi Kothari (Organising Secretary, NWSP); Mobile No. 9730216884; Email id:
nwsp2020@gmail.com
